stemMd: Jules: An artist's intention determines the meaning of a work. Mara: Intentions are relevant, but a work can acquire meanings its artist never anticipated. They disagree about whether

options.label: A
options.textMd: a work must be visual to have meaning.

options.label: D
options.textMd: viewers can learn about an artist's intentions.

options.label: E
options.textMd: a work can legitimately have a meaning outside the artist's intention.

explanationMd: Jules treats intention as determinative; Mara permits meanings beyond it. The disagreement concerns the boundary set by intention, not whether intentions exist or whether every interpretation is acceptable.

distractorRationale.c: Mara permits additional meanings, not every possible interpretation.
